import importlib.util
import os
import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path


SCRIPT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2] / "scripts" / "native_config.py"
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("course_native_config", SCRIPT)
module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
assert spec and spec.loader
spec.loader.exec_module(module)


class NativeConfigTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_native_environment_uses_loopback_course_database_and_listener(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
            env_file = Path(directory) / ".env"
            env_file.write_text(
                "LW_POSTGRES_USER=lw\nLW_POSTGRES_PASSWORD=test-password\nLW_INTERNAL_TOKEN=general-token\n"
                "LW_COURSE_PLANNER_TOKEN=planner-token\nLW_COURSE_DIAGNOSTIC_TOKEN=diagnostic-token\n",
                encoding="utf-8",
            )
            old = dict(os.environ)
            try:
                os.environ.clear()
                os.environ["LW_INFRA_ENV_FILE"] = str(env_file)
                environment = module.native_environment()
            finally:
                os.environ.clear()
                os.environ.update(old)
        self.assertIn("@127.0.0.1:15432/lw_course?sslmode=disable", environment["DATABASE_URL"])
        self.assertEqual("127.0.0.1", environment["HTTP_HOST"])
        self.assertEqual("18083", environment["HTTP_PORT"])
        self.assertEqual("nats://127.0.0.1:4222", environment["NATS_URL"])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
